label: DOMAIN_INVENTORY_V1
author: maxime@qwokka.fr
summary: Single-venue development corpus. All 168 sessions, 2803 dives, 239 proxy videos derive from one training pool (location field NULL in DB — no structured venue data). Paris canary (IMG_1937.mov) is the only external sample and is FIREWALL_PROTECTED.

venue.note: All session.location values are NULL. No structured venue metadata recorded.
venue.inference: Date range 2024-10-30 to 2026-08-22 with consistent platform/apparatus mix strongly suggests a single training facility.

session.note: Date range is the primary proxy for temporal/seasonal diversity within the single venue.

execution.note: Codes starting with 5 = inward group (hurdle required). ~5.6% of corpus.

proxy_media.duration_note: duration_seconds not populated in DB; filesystem ls shows 239 files

external_canary.policy: Do NOT train on IMG_1937.mov. Do NOT tune using its results.

detection_domain_gaps: Single venue: no variation in pool background, lane lines, lighting angle
Single athlete (Maxime + occasional training partners): no body diversity
L1 trained on 38 frames from 14 dives — narrow temporal coverage
L1 produces 0 detections on Paris canary (different pool/crowd/lighting)
COCO detects spectators, not diver, during flight phase
No structured location/venue metadata to stratify splits by venue
diversity_proxies_available: Date range: 22 months → seasonal light/crowd variation
Platform_type + height: 9 apparatus variants → different camera angles
Dive codes: inward/forward/backward/reverse/twisting → different body orientations
Time of day: not recorded but implicit in session timestamps
dataset_design_v2_recommendation: Add 40-70 frames from diverse (date, apparatus, dive_code) dives to widen the training distribution. Use date-range holdout as the primary generalization proxy within the single-venue corpus. Keep springboard_1m hurdle dives over-represented to match canary apparatus.
